videos.title: Outstanding Speaker Distinction: National Capital Markets Debate Competition
videos.description: Demonstrated exceptional public speaking, strategic policy analysis, and persuasive advocacy at the National Capital Markets Debate Competition hosted by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
videos.details: Demonstrated exceptional public speaking, strategic policy analysis, and persuasive advocacy at the National Capital Markets Debate Competition hosted by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Recognized as the Overall Best Speaker at the Provincial Level, followed by commanding performances on the national stage to earn Overall Best Speaker honors in both the Quarter-Finals and the Grand Finals. Through rigorous arguments on economic governance, capital markets development, and investor protection, consistently delivered high-impact, evidence-based presentations that earned top ratings from judges across every competitive stage.
